simple.meaning: בּוּל (bûwl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “produce (of the earth, etc.).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Job, Isaiah, beginning at Job 40:20. Its contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בּוּל (H944).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בּוּל (bûwl) / H944 is traced through Job 40:20, Isaiah 44:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H944. bul II. בּוּל noun masculine product, produce , see יבול . בּוּל noun [masculine] produce, outgrowth (abbreviated or scribal error for foregoing) — only singular construct ׳ב הָרִים Job 40:20 ; also ׳ב עֵץ Isa 44:19 the produce of a tree , i.e. a block of wood.
